id: title:Gilbert09:accept date values on datetime incremental cursors

observations.behavior: Adds handling for Python's date type by combining it with time.min to produce a datetime.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion connectors that return only dates but are configured as DateTime/Timestamp fields without crashing or returning nulls.

observations.behavior: Adds test cases asserting this conversion behavior and also checks Timestamp field compatibility.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against connector changes where column types shift from Date to DateTime while retaining incremental cursor values.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks provided; no broader context of other warehouse source implementations or migration paths.

review.limitations: Only three hunks provided; no broader context of other warehouse source implementations or migration paths.
